summary: Promote the reviewed operational list pattern and add stable data-grid and authentication compositions so product teams and AI agents can assemble mature pages from En UI-owned responsive anatomy.

components: Add stable ListPage, DataGrid, FilterPanel, and LoginPage composition APIs without changing existing component props.
consumers: Teams can import mature page patterns from the package root and direct AI agents to prefer them over application-owned shells.

documentation: Update the landing page, installation/customization documentation, and packaged consumer skill with pattern selection guidance.
foundations: Reuse the approved dense typography, semantic spacing, elevation, target-size, and contrast foundations without new raw values.
patterns: Promote the reviewed operational list page and add data-management and authentication reference patterns.
screenshots: Add desktop and mobile baselines for the data-grid and login patterns and retain catalog-wide WCAG 2.2 AA scanning.
